A '''macrobinocular viewplate''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] attachment, affixed to a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. The viewplate offered the wearer up to fifty times magnification, and could be integrated with an external [[Rangefinder/Legends|targeting rangefinder]] to display data including range and target movement in a full three-hundred and sixty degree radius. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] incorporated a macrobinocular viewplate with an [[Infrared receptor|infrared scanner]].<ref name="EssentialArmor" />
